messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — Cinderlane's integrations team just flipped on a new product feed. We're seeing a 3x QPS bump from their Prod key and they messaged CS asking about lower-latency options.
Min: Noted. Any concrete numbers on the bump?
Aisha: From metrics: avg tokens/min jumped from ~12k to ~36k. p95 latency for their text-gen route went from ~420ms to ~1.1s. Error rate still low, but tail latency is spiking during sustained bursts.
ops-bot: Alert: workspace=cinderlane prod-key=wl_prod rate_increase=3.0x latency_p95=1100ms ts=2360001225
Jared: They also mentioned wanting a private Dedicated pool for sensitive data. Renewal for that account is ~9 weeks out — flagging as potential risk if we don't stabilize perf or offer a clear plan.
Min: Short-term mitigation: route heavy campaign traffic through our batch-optimize policy, enable prefix/KV caching, and add traffic shaping on the client side. Long-term: propose a small Dedicated pod with autoscale windows. Need sustained throughput numbers to size.
Aisha: Ravi from CS captured an ask: they expect ~200k tokens/min peak during campaigns (about 2x current observed peaks). Can SE confirm whether 2x GPUs would cover that?
Linda: Quick back-of-envelope: A100 x1 handles ~60k tokens/min for this model/config (@512 context). So two GPUs ~120k sustained. To hit ~200k we'd recommend 4 GPUs, or a 2-GPU setup running a q8_0 quantized variant which might get to ~160k. I'll put together exact perf numbers.
Jared: :eyes: From a renewal angle, we can offer a short Dedicated pilot (2–4 GPUs depending on sizing) with a 20% pilot discount and migration support. That would both address perf and create a path to a commitment. Aisha — can you coordinate an enablement + checklist?
Aisha: On it. I'll draft a one-pager enablement playbook: routing policy snippet, cache config, canary rollout steps, and support escalation path. Will share draft by EOD tomorrow.
Min: SE action: I'll assemble a perf matrix (variants x GPUs x tokens/min) and a runbook for toggling q8_0 safely. Need their sample prompt set and token distribution to simulate. Aisha, can you request that from the PM?
Aisha: Pinged their PM this morning for the prompt set and example payloads. Also logging their feature request: better token-level cost breakdown per route — they said visibility would help justify a bigger commit.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4821 — Dedicated pilot proposal for Cinderlane (assignee: Aisha). Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-4821
Jared: I'll prep a renewal exec summary with pricing options and the pilot offer. If we can move them into a pilot before month-end, that should materially reduce churn risk. Will ask Sales Ops for a contract template.
Aisha: Action items recap: 1) Min/Linda SE perf sims (due in 48h). 2) Aisha enablement playbook (EOD tomorrow). 3) Jared renewal summary + pilot terms (by Friday). 4) Schedule customer + SE + Sales sync — propose Friday 11am PT. Who's available?
Min: Free.
Linda: Free, will join.
Jared: Available.
Aisha: Invite going out now :calendar:
